cases.id: grep-operations.test.ts::GrepOperations > accepts a deprecated $name readFile hook without calling it
cases.title: accepts a deprecated $name readFile hook without calling it
cases.reason: Rust deliberately exposes no JavaScript GrepOperations or deprecated readFile hook. grep-searcher emits matches and context from the same decoded search stream; the listed public-result regressions cover the equivalent context behavior without inventing an adapter API. Related Rust regressions (not substitutes for this absent adapter API): plugins/tools/pi-plugin-grep/src/lib.rs::prints_overlapping_context_once_and_keeps_last_match_trailing_context, plugins/tools/pi-plugin-grep/src/lib.rs::decodes_utf16_context_and_lossy_utf8_search_rows.

cases.title: allows custom operations without a readFile hook
cases.reason: Rust's built-in grep is intentionally an in-process implementation with no JavaScript custom-operations seam. Context works without any readFile callback or external rg process, as covered by the listed tests. Related Rust regressions (not substitutes for this absent adapter API): plugins/tools/pi-plugin-grep/src/lib.rs::prints_overlapping_context_once_and_keeps_last_match_trailing_context, plugins/tools/pi-plugin-grep/src/lib.rs::ignores_ripgrep_configuration_and_external_binary_state.

cases.id: find-abort-before-spawn.test.ts::find abort before fd starts > does not start fd after an abort during the .git lookup
cases.title: does not start fd after an abort during the .git lookup
cases.reason: Rust intentionally has no fd child process or asynchronous JavaScript pathExists hook to observe during .git lookup. The equivalent cancellation boundary rejects before glob/filesystem traversal, ancestor lookup checks the signal on every step, and the external-fd independence test proves no fd executable is started. Related Rust regressions (not substitutes for this absent adapter API): plugins/tools/pi-plugin-find/src/lib.rs::pre_aborted_find_returns_before_glob_or_filesystem_work, plugins/tools/pi-plugin-find/src/lib.rs::is_independent_of_external_fd_binary_configuration.

cases.id: image-resize-worker-teardown.test.ts::image resize worker teardown > does not resolve until the resize worker has finished terminating
cases.title: does not resolve until the resize worker has finished terminating
cases.reason: Legacy creates a dedicated Node Worker per image and asserts that Worker.terminate finishes before resolution. Rust uses runtime-owned Tokio blocking-pool tasks, with no per-image thread termination API. Coding awaits the processing task before emitting ToolExecutionEnd, recording history, and making the next provider request; those handoffs are asserted in the product integration tests.
